summary: Verified end-to-end on cosma-ai-studio (TS/React, 1000+ files). Pipeline generalizes mechanically (mine→learn→probe→harness). Trustworthy non-degenerate reading: cold_rate_control=100%, cold_rate_project=13%, kb_rate_project=25%, kb_earned=13% (1/8). Coverage is the bottleneck — 150-candidate cap kept only 20 notes. Key bugs: (1) candidate explosion on large repos (2457 mined; 500-cap times out ~20min, 150-cap fine in 514s — cap is wrong architecture, needs a queue+cursor like the judge); (2) daemon-injection on a foreign workspace was policy-denied; live retrieval path on foreign workspaces unexercised. 20 kept notes are high-quality load-bearing invariants.

subject: Verify onboarding end-to-end on a DIFFERENT repo
description: Prove the whole onboarding pipeline is NOT self-coupled to the orchestrator's own repo (the original spike's flaw). Pick a separate project, run drop-in onboarding (miners → agentic learner → review → inject), generate its competence probes, and confirm: (1) the pipeline runs clean on a repo it has never seen; (2) the KB-equipped agent measurably beats the cold agent on that project's probes ('KB earned it' rate > 0); (3) the review gate works (dry-run, confirm, reversibility). Report the competence delta. This is the real-world proof that onboarding works as a feature. Depends on the learning loop + the drop-in entry.
